name: Query Builder
description: Build Thymer search queries in plain English or with colour-coded chips — right on Search, Upcoming and every other query field.
instructions: Click into any query field (Search, Upcoming…) and press the "Build" pill — or press Alt+Q in any text field. Describe what you want in plain English, or click + to add filters; the live query, a plain-English readout and the matching items update as you go. ⌘↵ (Ctrl+Enter) writes the query into the field. Everything runs locally — no API key needed.
